title: XP How to make player turn by pressing a button and an arrow key?

posts.author: DoggoDoesStuff
posts.body:
I am running into a problem when I try to make the player turn by pressing the X button ('A' on the keyboard) as well as pressing another arrow key.
I have an event in the map where it turns on a couple of switches, 'PlayerMovementON' and 'Turning'. I then have a common event called 'Player Movement' which is turned on with condition switch 'PlayerMovementON'. I have another common event called 'Player Turn' which is turned on with condition switch 'Turning'. I have one more common event, 'EnemyMovement', that just moves the enemy (or in this case 2 enemies) a tile when it is called in the Player Movement common event.
So far, the Player Movement works. The player moves a tile and the enemies also move a tile simultaneously. However, when I press the X button ('A' on keyboard) as well as pressing an arrow key to try and turn on the spot, the enemies do not move a tile (which is what I want) but the player still moves a tile instead of turning on the spot, on the same tile.
Can anyone help me figure out how to make the player turn on the spot rather than moving a tile?
Below should be screenshots of the common events 'PlayerMovement' and 'PlayerTurn' as well as the Event on the Map.

posts.author: DoggoDoesStuff
posts.body: for some reason after testing it, the enemies move when they're not supposed to. I don't know why it happened but I would like a fix for that too please. Thanks.
